findings.reason: the sentence tells item 1's attribution, not only the shadow, and the production routed pick the done-when samples is one of the picks that pays the second computation.
findings.text: §12 states the estimate "runs inside `candidates()` on every pick ... On the shadow path it also runs once before `pick()` starts, in `reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py`, untimed. So a shadow pick computes it twice", but the pre-`pick()` call is made by `dispatch_picker_selection` (reckon/crew/dispatch_picker.py:251, before `pick()` at :269), and that function is reached on the routed production path too: with `routing.picker: route`, `deferred_shadow_selection` is false (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:620-626), so a routed dispatch calls `dispatch_picker_selection` inline at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:642 and computes the estimate twice exactly as the shadow does — only the direct `crew pick` verb (reckon/crew_dispatch_commands.py:634) computes it once. The done-when then samples "the first 50 production picks", i.e. the routed path the sentence does not name.
